notes.title: Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 1 - 5 Now Available!
notes.content:
Get motivated to restore nature with beautiful Japanese folklore-inspired music from Okami that was just added to Steam!

 Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 1
 Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 2
 Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 3
 Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 4
 Okami Original Soundtrack Vol. 5

All of these are available in FLAC, MP3 and AAC formats so you can optimize your download prioritizing quality or file size. 

So get your headphones on, head over to our soundtrack page and enjoy these iconic tunes!

notes.title: OKAMI HD / 大神 絶景版 - Minor Update Patch Now Available
notes.content:
Hello OKAMI HD fans,

A new update patch for the game was issued on February 15, 2018 at 6pm PST. This patch fixes a few minor bugs with the game.

For all the latest news on Capcom games, please follow us at Capcom-Unity. Thank you for all of your support!

Best Regards,

Capcom USA Customer Support
